name: Rechab
overview: The name Rechab appears in Scripture primarily as the son of Rimmon the Beerothite, who, along with his brother Baanah, murdered Ish-bosheth, the son of Saul, by striking him down and beheading him (2 Samuel 4:5-7). They brought Ish-bosheth’s head to King David, claiming to have avenged him against Saul’s house, but David condemned their act and had them put to death (2 Samuel 4:8-10). Rechab is also noted as the father of Jehonadab, the ancestor of the Rechabites, and as the father of Malchiah, highlighting his family’s distinct place in biblical history.
